newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: MOST S.KOREA'S BIGGEST SHAREHOLDERS IN MANAGEMENT.
newsitem.headline: MOST S.KOREA'S BIGGEST SHAREHOLDERS IN MANAGEMENT.

text.p: About 80 percent of the largest shareholders in South Korea's listed companies participated in management, the Korea Stock Exchange said on Monday.
Of 485 listed firms with individuals as their largest shareholders, 78.3 percent or 380 companies had their biggest shareholders participating in management as permanent directors, the exchange said.
It said the largest shareholders and their relatives accounted for more than 50 percent of permanent directors in 72 companies.
